type_definitions.name: TextbookDisposition

workflows.description: LaTeX textbook archive extraction, thematic TeX organization, truthful per-unit job queuing, and standard Lean workflow gates for each target unit.

epistemic_contract.assurance_justification: Each occurrence preserves its own generated or computed provenance; the final wrapper follows the final occurrence.
epistemic_contract.defeater_rationale: Evidence labels remain capped until native adapters and independent behavioral oracles execute.
defeaters: A structural or fake-handler run does not establish native execution, mathematical correctness, or semantic equivalence.
observations: The canonical hook registry fixes hook order, owner skills, declared outputs, and gate text.
epistemic_contract.output_meaning: The final domain-specific artifact produced by the layered textbook_theory_autoformalization_loop shell.
epistemic_contract.question: What typed artifacts and dispositions result from the declared textbook_theory_autoformalization_loop contract?
epistemic_contract.subject: The exact source artifacts and gates traversed by textbook_theory_autoformalization_loop.

reasoning_projection.description: Extract and organize textbook theory, prepare chapter-scoped jobs, autoformalize and ground Lean units, run the gate stack, and aggregate the batch.
reasoning_projection.name: AutoformalizeTextbook

occurrences.rationale: Extract theorem-like units, proofs, and exact source provenance.
Organize source-preserved units into coherent chapter or section bundles.
Build an ordered chapter queue retaining proof and source identity.
Create draft, reuse, proof, and support-only jobs with source packets.
Run object-level autoformalization jobs and maximize mathlib grounding.
Run Lean, compilation, source-drift, and artifact-realness gates.
Run unified consistency and aggregate completed, reused, blocked, proof, and support-only unit outcomes.

reasoning_projection.projection_scope: one complete textbook batch with source, job, Lean, gate, and per-unit outcome structure
